title: Storeys on lots less than 100 m2 (R100-SL): minimum two, maximum four
text: Table 2.10a Modified provisions for housing on lots less than 100m2. 3.2 Building height, C3.2.1: Minimum two storey building height. Maximum four storey building height in accordance with Table 3.2a.

replaces.note: current Part C Table 2.10a (register ch3-042 current_source); values not compared

notes: Table 2.10a modified provision for C3.2.1 (Chapter 3 p26, register ch3-040; C2.10.1 applies Table 2.10a to grouped dwellings in R100-SL). Table 2.10a footnote 1 (abutting a non-R100-SL property) is not attached to 3.2.
